title: TaskFlow
tagline: Taskflow allows users to browse and select from services which are shortlisted.
description: Taskflow allows users to browse and select from services such as house cleaning, pet care, and more. Once they choose a service, they can pay for it using Flow tokens. This integration of blockchain technology enables faster transactions, lower fees, and increased transparency in the payment process.
how_its_made: Task management system with blockchain integration, allowing users to interact with tasks and potentially handle token-based transactions on the Flow blockchain. The frontend is built with modern web technology(Next.js) while the backend logic is handled through Flow blockchain smart contracts written in Cadence.
